beats.text: In golden Lanka, the ten-headed king Ravana sat on his throne, among his ministers.
Surpanakha burst into the court and showed Ravana what had been done to her. 'You sit here drinking while a man defeats your army!'
She described Sita's beauty and goaded him. 'She should be your queen, brother. Bring her to Lanka.'
Ravana flew across the ocean in his golden flying chariot, pulled by donkeys with demon faces.
He went to Maricha, the demon Rama had once thrown across the ocean, now living as a hermit.
'Do not touch Rama,' Maricha begged. 'I have felt his arrow. Every tree in this forest looks like Rama to me.'
But Ravana grew furious and threatened him. 'Help me, or face my anger.'
Maricha agreed in despair. 'Either way, my end is near. Better that it comes from Rama.'
